units: Illustrative interval positions; host contribution in normalized affected-tissue days on identical season pairs.
caption: Host exposure windows change climate–disease attribution in European wheat. On the same 4,117 model–draw–year pairs, host contributions are −5.30 normalized affected-tissue days over whole host windows and +0.57 days over shared elapsed time. Intervals are schematic, without a date scale. The sign change concerns conditional model attribution of a symptom-tissue proxy.
